notes:
Fixed
- A connected Resolve no longer freezes the app. Talking to a running Resolve blocked the UI thread; the calls are off it now, and "Resolve is not running" is only said when Resolve genuinely isn't running.
- Freeing a model while another stage was on the GPU killed the app. The queues now hand the GPU over instead of pulling it out from under a live stage, and the pause/defer releases go through the same gate.
- Every AI rough cut placed each clip one frame short, and `/cover` never worked at all. Synced clips with no timecode timeline now get an offer instead of a wrong answer, and a build freezes the plan it was approved from.
- "No shots" is an answer. The embeddings stage used to wait on it forever, stalling three stages behind it. An offline skip also no longer claims credit for a successful pass.
- Camera RAW is decodable, so shot detection stops skipping it as undecodable, and the media pool scan places scratch audio and links it to its picture.
- The assistant chat panel was dead on every send, and three queues were invisible to keep-awake, so the Mac could sleep mid-job.
- MCP hardening: the Quit/Export gate holes are closed, Resolve access is serialized, and the transport is more forgiving of a slow client.
- Diagnostics: a VLM crash that escaped its sandbox is contained, the transcription tally survives into the bundle, and the Whisper log gives one clip one verdict.
